paite: Nob a siampu Ahimelek kiang ah David ahong hi. Ahimelek in ling kawm in David ana dawn a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia tangtat na chia, kuamah tonpih na neih louh?" achi hi.
heading: Saul A Pan David Ataimang

paite: David in siampu Ahimelek kiang ah, "Kumpipa'n thilhih ding in thu ahon pia a, ka kiang ah, ka hon thilhihsak tup leh ka hon thupiak kuamah in thei kei heh, achi bikbek hi. Ka sikhate amun ding uh ka sehsakta," achi hi.
Huaiziak in tu in, "Na khut ah bang a-om a? Tanghou beu nga ahihkeileh na neih lamlam hon pia in," achi hi.
Siampu in David adawng a, "Tanghou vantang ka nei kei a, himahleh tanghou siangthou bel ka nei hi, tangvalte numei a pan akihepkhiak nak uleh," achi hi.

David in siampu adawng a, akiang ah, "Tu ni thum sung numei a pan ka kihemkhe vek taktak uhi. Ka hong pawtkhiak dek lai in leng tangvalte tui-um belsuan asiangthou a, tanghou leng vantang ahi a, ahi, tuni tui-um belsuan sung asiansak mah bang in," achi hi.
Huchi in siampu in tanghou siang- thou apeta hi. Huai ah lah tanghou koih alak ni ua tanghou lum a khen dia TOUPA ma a pan lak pen kia lou ngal tanghou dang a-om ngal kei hi.
Huai ni in Saul sikhate lak a mi khat TOUPA ma a zekaisak a-om a; amin Doeg ahi. Amah Edom mi, Saul ganchingmi lak a heutupen ahi.
David in Ahimelek kiang ah, "Teipi hiam, namsau hiam na kem kei maw? Kumpipa hon sawlna thukin ahih ziak in ka namsau leh ka galvan bangmah ka hon tawi man kei hi,” achi hi.

Siampu in, “Philistia mi Goliath, Elah Phaizang a na thahpa namsau, ngai in, siampu puanak nung ah puan a tuam in a-om hi. Huai na laknopleh la in. Huai lou ngal adang a-om kei," achi hi. David in, "Huai val a-om ding hia, hon pe dih ve," achi hi.
Huchi in David adingh a, huai ni in Saul lau in ataimang a, Gath kumpipa Akish kiang ah apaita hi.
Akish sikhate'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi huai gam kumpipa David ahi kei maw? Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chih lou kawm in atungtang la in asa zuazua uh ahi kei maw?" achi uhi.
David in huai thute alungsim in apai a, Gath kumpipa Akish alau mahmah hi.
Huchi in ama ah a-omdan ahihlamdang a, amitmuh un akihaisak hi. Akhut in kongkhakte aham ekek a, akhamul ah achil aluangsak zengzung hi.
Huchi in Akish in asikhate kiang ah, "Enta unla, mihai ahih na thei ua, bangziak a ka kiang a hon pi na hi ua?
Mihai ka kitaksap ziak in hia hiai mi ahaidan hihlang dia ka ma a na hon pi uh? Hiai mi ka inn ah ahong lut tel mahmah ding maw?" achi hi.
